nodes.label: Quantitative LLM Quality Sensor Plan
nodes.description: Proposed Promptfoo-based inferential regression suite for Tier 1 dialogue, Tier 2 simulation, and intent parsing, complementing structural snapshots and security pentests.

nodes.label: Four-Judge Borda Quality Harness
nodes.description: Anachronism rules, Talkie period likelihood, a small dialect oracle, and DeepSeek coherence scoring are calibrated on synthetic cross-provider pairs and combined by Borda rank.

nodes.label: Shared Training, Regression, and Serving Signal
nodes.description: The same judge scores are intended to drive DPO data, offline regression gates, and inference-time best-of-K selection, making quality changes comparable across stages.

edges.description: The four-judge calibrated harness is the proposed inferential sensor implementation.
Reusing one score across stages motivates the shared judge harness.
